components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 2rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion), color var(--motion), transform var(--motion); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact labeled input for timer and account forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-2); color: var(--text-muted); font: 500 0.75rem/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-primary); caret-color: var(--primary); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-body); transition: border-color var(--motion), background-color var(--motion), box-shadow var(--motion); } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--surface-1); outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-subtle); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Current route in the compact workspace navigation.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 11rem; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2rem; padding: 0 var(--space-3); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-muted); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-body); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--motion), background-color var(--motion); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-secondary); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-nav-item-active::before { position: absolute; left: 0.35rem; width: 2px; height: 0.875rem; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--primary); content: ""; }

components.name: Selected Filter Chip

components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 1.875rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-muted); font: 500 0.75rem var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color var(--motion), background-color var(--motion); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-chip-active { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 55%, var(--border)); background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--text-primary); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Hairline panel with flat, divided weekly statistics rows.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: var(--space-4); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-panel-header { margin: calc(var(--space-4) * -1) calc(var(--space-4) * -1) 0; padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-panel-header h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-primary); font: 600 1rem/1.3 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-panel-body { padding-top: var(--space-4); } .ds-week-day { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-3); padding: var(--space-3) 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; } .ds-week-day:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-week-day strong { color: var(--text-primary); font: 600 0.8125rem var(--font-body); } .ds-week-day span { color: var(--text-muted); font: 400 0.6875rem var(--font-body); }

components.name: Timer Row
components.description: Selected course in the sidebar, with its own color and tabular total.
components.css: .ds-timer-row { display: grid; gap: 1px; width: 11rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.45rem var(--space-2); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-secondary); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--motion), border-color var(--motion); } .ds-timer-row:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 72%, transparent); background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-timer-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-timer-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-body); } .ds-timer-dot { width: 0.45rem; height: 0.45rem; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--timer-color, #111827); } .ds-timer-total { padding-left: 1rem; color: var(--text-subtle); font: 400 0.6875rem var(--font-body); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-timer-row .ds-timer-name, .ds-timer-row .ds-timer-total { color: var(--text-primary); }

letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-timer-course { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 52%, #ffffff); font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-timer-dial { position: relative; display: grid; width: 15rem; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: conic-gradient(var(--accent) 110deg, var(--surface-3) 0deg); } .ds-timer-dial::after { position: absolute; inset: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--canvas); content: ""; } .ds-timer-face { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-timer-time { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 52%, #ffffff); font: 500 2.65rem/1 var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-timer-controls { display: grid; width: min(100%, 24rem); grid-template-columns: minmax(5rem, 1fr) auto minmax(5rem, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); } .ds-timer-controls button { min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); font: 500 0.8125rem var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: color var(--motion), border-color var(--motion), background-color var(--motion); } .ds-timer-adjust { width: 100%; max-width: 6.25rem; justify-self: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-2) 74%, transparent); color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-timer-adjust:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, var(--border)); components.name: FocusArc Brand Mark
components.description: Product-specific progress-ring mark in the compact sidebar identity.
components.html: FocusArc
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; color: var(--text-primary); font: 600 0.9375rem var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-brand-mark { display: grid; width: 1.625rem; height: 1.625rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 76%, white); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--primary); color: #fff; } .ds-brand-mark svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; overflow: visible; } .ds-brand-track, .ds-brand-arc { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-brand-track { opacity: 0.28; } .ds-brand-arc { stroke-dasharray: 28 38; stroke-linecap: round; transform: rotate(-90deg); transform-origin: center; } .ds-brand-center { fill: currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
FocusArc behaves like a precise desk timer: present, readable, and composed. Its compact workspace supports an individual studying beside other material, with the active timer as the single point of emphasis. The atmosphere is calm, distraction-free, and quietly luxurious through alignment and restraint.

The interface takes Linear's near-black layers, fine cool-gray borders, restrained lavender, and clean type as a visual authority, then applies them to a personal study tool. Course colors give timers their own identity without turning the surrounding controls into decoration. Light mode preserves the same hierarchy with cool white and gray surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, product-focused hierarchy for a small desktop window.
Flat layered surfaces separated by hairlines.
One interface accent, with user-defined course colors confined to timer identity, its primary control, and data.
Short, subtle state transitions and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lavender identifies interface action and focus; user-selected HEX colors identify a timer, its dial, its primary timer control, and related data only.

rules.name: The Legible Clock Rule
rules.body: Keep elapsed time stable through tabular numerals and make it visually dominant only in the timer workspace.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Prefer a surface step and fine border to a raised card shadow.

dos: Do keep the timer readable and controllable at 900 × 700.
Do use the stepped surfaces, hairlines, and compact spacing rhythm for secondary views.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, tabular time values, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use a course's chosen HEX only for that timer's identity, primary control, and related data.
donts: Don't add decorative gradients, glows, or shadows to resting surfaces.
Don't use course colors as global control or navigation accents.
Don't enlarge secondary headings or cards until they compete with the active timer.
